reference: GNU coreutils 9.7 seq, invoked by system Bash on the reference side; stderr is compared byte for byte after the shell's script-line prefix is removed.
coverage: Guest compatibility pass 6 (G90): GNU diagnostic wording for operand and usage errors.
exclusions: Only diagnostics are covered here; the reviewed suite in suites/ covers ordinary operation.

cases.purpose: G90: usage errors end with coreutils' "Try 'seq --help' for more information." line, not bash's usage synopsis.
cases.script:
{ seq || echo rc=$?; } 2>err
{ seq a || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
{ seq 1 2 3 4 || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
{ seq --bogus || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
{ seq 1 0 2 || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
{ seq -s || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
{ seq -w -f %g 1 || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
sed 's/^fixture: line [0-9]*: //' err >&2
rm err
